The Champion's death can be delayed by healing or similar effects while in the decaying state, but cannot be prevented unless the Champion gets a Takedown. Champions can only delay their death once. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Loyalty Program
abilities.description: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, shielding allies and damaging and slowing enemies hit.
abilities.tooltip: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing surrounding enemies and enemies hit by 30% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Allies hit gain {{ shieldcalc }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Hostile Takeover
abilities.description: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, causing any enemies hit to go Berserk.
abilities.tooltip: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, Berserking enemies for {{ berserkduration }} seconds, causing them to Attack the nearest unit, prioritizing their allies. While Berserk , enemies gain {{ bonusattackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Granite Shield
abilities.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.

abilities.name: Seismic Shard
abilities.description: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.
abilities.tooltip: Malphite launches a shard of earth at an enemy, dealing {{ qdamagecalc }} magic damage and Slowing them by {{ e2 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Malphite also steals the amount Slowed , gaining it as Move Speed for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Malphite gains {{ bonusarmorpassive*100 }}% Armor (%i:scaleArmor%{{ f1 }}) . This effect is increased to {{ bonusarmorpassive*300 }}% (%i:scaleArmor%{{ f2 }}) while Granite Shield is active. Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional {{ totalbonusdamage }} physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals {{ thunderclapsplash }} physical damage in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks for the next {{ thunderclapbuffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ground Slam
abilities.description: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.
abilities.tooltip: Malphite slams the ground, dealing {{ edamagecalc }} magic damage and reducing Attack Speed by {{ asreduction }}% for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.description: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.
abilities.tooltip: Malphite charges with the force of a landslide, dashing Unstoppably. At the end of the dash, Malphite Knocks Up for {{ knockupduration }} seconds and deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mark of the Kindred
abilities.description: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.

abilities.name: Dance of Arrows
abilities.description: Kindred tumbles and shoots up to three arrows at nearby targets.
abilities.tooltip: Kindred vaults, firing an arrow at up to 3 enemies, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and gaining {{ totalqattackspeed }} Attack Speed for {{ e8 }} seconds. While inside of Wolf's Frenzy , this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to {{ e4 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Wolf's Frenzy
abilities.description: Wolf enrages and attacks enemies around him.  Lamb passively gains stacks by moving and attacking. When fully charged, Lamb's next attack restores health.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Kindred gains stacks as they move and attack. At 100 stacks, Kindred's next Attack restores up to {{ attackheal }} Health based on their missing Health. Active: Kindred claims a territory, ordering Wolf to bite at the last enemy Lamb Attacked. Wolf's bites deal {{ basewolfdamage }} plus {{ percentwolfdamage }} current Health magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mounting Dread
abilities.description: Lamb fires a carefully placed shot, slowing the target. If Lamb attacks the target two more times, her third attack instead directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, savaging them for massive damage.
abilities.tooltip: Kindred weakens an enemy, Slowing them by {{ totalslow }}% for {{ slowduration }} second. Kindred's third Attack against the target within {{ totalduration }} seconds of each other directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, dealing {{ basebitedamage }} plus {{ percentbitedamage }} missing Health physical damage . Wolf's pounce critically strikes for {{ basebitedamage }} plus {{ critdamage }} missing Health physical damage instead if they are below {{ healththreshold }} Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Lamb's Respite
abilities.description: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.
abilities.tooltip: Kindred blesses the ground for {{ e2 }} seconds, allowing no unit, ally, enemy, or neutral to die while inside. Upon reaching 10% Health, units can't be damaged or healed while still inside the zone. When the blessing ends, all units inside heal for {{ e1 }} Health .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Berserker Rage
abilities.description: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

abilities.name: Undertow
abilities.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.
abilities.tooltip: Olaf throws an axe, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for up to {{ e3 }} seconds (based on distance travelled). Champions hit lose {{ shredamount*100 }}% Armor for {{ debuffduration }} seconds. If Olaf picks up the axe, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to {{ tooltipcdrefund }} seconds, or fully refunded if {{ tooltipcdrefund }} seconds has elapsed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Tough It Out
abilities.description: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.
abilities.tooltip: Olaf gains {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ duration }} seconds, and {{ baseshield }} plus {{ shieldpercmissinghp*100 }}% missing Health Shield (up to a maximum of {{ maxshieldcalc }} Shield below {{ thresholdformax*100 }}% Health) for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Reckless Swing
abilities.description: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.
abilities.tooltip: Olaf ferociously swings his axes, dealing {{ totaldamage }} true damage . If the enemy dies, the cost is refunded. Attacks lower the Cooldown of this Ability by 1 second, increased to 2 seconds when attacking monsters.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ragnarok
abilities.description: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Olaf gains {{ resists }} Armor and {{ resists }} Magic Resist . Active: Olaf cleanses all Immobilizing and Disabling effects on himself and becomes immune to them for {{ duration }} seconds. While active, Olaf gains {{ ad }} Attack Damage . Hitting a champion with an Attack or Reckless Swing extends the duration by {{ durationextension }} seconds. Additionally, Olaf gains {{ haste*100 }}% Move Speed towards enemy champions for {{ hasteduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ki Barrier
abilities.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

abilities.name: Twilight Assault
abilities.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.
abilities.tooltip: Shen recalls his Spirit Blade . Enemies hit by the pull are Slowed by {{ e4 }}% while moving away from Shen for the next {{ e5 }} seconds. Additionally, Shen's next {{ e3 }} Attacks deal an additional {{ baseflatdamage }} plus {{ basepercenthealth }} max Health magic damage . If Shen hit an enemy champion with the Spirit Blade , the damage is increased to {{ baseflatdamage }} plus {{ emppercenthealth }} max Health magic damage and he gains {{ e9 }}% Attack Speed for those Attacks.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Spirit's Refuge
abilities.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.
abilities.tooltip: Shen creates a defensive zone at his Spirit Blade for {{ e1 }} seconds. Attacks against allied champions in the zone are blocked. If there are no champions to protect in the zone when it starts, it will wait for up to {{ e2 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Shadow Dash
abilities.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Dealing damage with Twilight Assault or this Ability recovers {{ energyrefund }} Energy . Active: Shen dashes, Taunting champions and jungle monsters for {{ ccduration }} seconds and dealing {{ tauntdamage }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Stand United
abilities.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.
abilities.tooltip: Shen grants an allied champion anywhere on the map between {{ shield }} and {{ maxshield }} Shield based on their missing Health for {{ shieldduration }} seconds (max Shield at 60% missing Health). After channeling for {{ channelduration }} seconds, Shen teleports to his ally's location with his Spirit Blade .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ravenous Flock
abilities.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

abilities.name: Death's Hand
abilities.description: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.
abilities.tooltip: Swain unleashes 5 eldritch bolts, dealing {{ initialdamage }} magic damage plus {{ extraboltdamage }} magic damage per bolt past the first (max {{ maxdamage }} magic damage ).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Vision of Empire
abilities.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.
abilities.tooltip: Swain opens a demon eye, revealing a location for 1.5 seconds, then deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slow*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Champions hit grant Swain a Soul Fragment and are revealed for {{ revealduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Nevermove
abilities.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.
abilities.tooltip: Swain launches a wave of demonic power that returns, detonating on the first enemy hit to deal {{ secondarydamage }} magic damage and Root enemies in the area for {{ rootduration }} seconds. Rooting a champion allows Swain to reactivate this ability to pull all champions Rooted by Nevermove toward him, gaining a Soul Fragment for each.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Demonic Ascension
abilities.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.
abilities.tooltip: Swain frees the demon, which deals {{ damagecalc }} magic damage and drains {{ healingcalc }} Health per second from nearby enemies. His Demonic Energy depletes over time but can be recharged indefinitely by draining enemy Champions and is fully restored on Champion takedowns. After {{ demonflarecastdelay }} seconds and every {{ demonflarecooldowntooltip }} seconds thereafter, Swain can cast Demonflare while transformed, which deals {{ demonflaredamagetotal }} magic damage and Slows enemies by {{ demonflareslowamount*100 }}%, decaying over {{ demonflareslowduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Damnation
abilities.description: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.

abilities.name: Death Sentence
abilities.description: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.
abilities.tooltip: Thresh throws out his scythe, Stunning the first unit hit and Pulling them towards Thresh for {{ tauntlength }} seconds. The scythe does {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and also grants True Sight for the duration. Thresh can Recast this Ability to pull himself to the enemy. If this Ability hits, its Cooldown is reduced by {{ hitbonuscooldown }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dark Passage
abilities.description: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.
abilities.tooltip: Thresh throws his lantern, allowing an ally to click on it to dash to Thresh. The lantern also grants {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds to Thresh and the first ally champion to come in contact with it.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Flay
abilities.description: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Thresh's Attacks deal additional damage based on how long since he last Attacked. They deal between {{ pattackdamagemin }} and {{ pattackdamagemax }} magic damage . Active: Thresh whips his chains, Pulling or Pushing enemies in the direction of the swing. Enemies hit are also Slowed by {{ e2 }}% for {{ e4 }} second and take {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: The Box
abilities.description: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.
abilities.tooltip: Thresh creates a prison of spectral walls, Slowing champions by {{ e3 }}% for {{ e2 }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Walls break after one collision, and after one is broken, the rest deal no damage and Slow for half duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Double Strike
abilities.description: Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice.

abilities.name: Alpha Strike
abilities.description: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.
abilities.tooltip: Master Yi becomes Untargetable and teleports to rapidly strike enemies near his target, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to all enemies hit after {{ alphastrikebounces }} hits. This Ability can strike the same enemy repeatedly if there are no other targets, dealing {{ subsequenthitmultiplier*100 }}% damage for subsequent hits ( {{ subesquentdamage }} ), for a maximum single target total of {{ singletotaldamage }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Meditate
abilities.description: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time. In addition, Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike and pause the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander for each second he channels.
abilities.tooltip: Master Yi channels, restoring {{ totalheal }} Health over {{ healduration }} seconds. This healing is increased by up to {{ maxmissinghealthpercent*100 }}% based on Master Yi's missing Health. While channeling and for {{ drlinger }} seconds afterwards, he takes {{ initialdr }} reduced damage, decreased to {{ damagereduction*100 }}% after the first {{ initialextradrduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
abilities.resource: {{ basemanacost }} Mana (+{{ percentmanacostpersecond*100 }}% Max Mana per second)

abilities.name: Wuju Style
abilities.description: Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.
abilities.tooltip: Master Yi's Attacks deal an additional {{ totaldamage }} true damage for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Highlander
abilities.description: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extend Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Champion takedowns reduce the remaining Cooldown of Master Yi's basic Abilities by {{ rcooldownrefund*100 }}%. Active: Master Yi enters a trance, gaining {{ rmsbonus }}% Move Speed , {{ rasbonus }}% Attack Speed , and immunity to Slows for {{ rduration }} seconds. Champion takedowns extend the duration of this Ability by {{ rkillassistextension }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: The Darkin Scythe
abilities.description: Kayn wields an ancient weapon and fights Rhaast, the darkin within it, for control. Either the Darkin will triumph, or Kayn will master Rhaast and become the Shadow Assassin . Darkin: Heal for a percentage of spell damage dealt to champions. Shadow Assassin: For the first few seconds in combat with enemy champions, deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Reaping Slash
abilities.description: Kayn dashes, then slashes. Both deal damage.
abilities.tooltip: Kayn dashes then spins his scythe, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to enemies he passes through, then deals the damage again to nearby enemies. Darkin Slayer: Instead deal {{ darkinflatdamage }} plus {{ darkinpercentdamage }} max Health physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Blade's Reach
abilities.description: Kayn damages and slows targets in a line.
abilities.tooltip: Kayn swipes his scythe upward, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and Slowing enemies hit by {{ e3 }}%, decaying over {{ e5 }} seconds. Shadow Assassin: Kayn can move while using this Ability and increases its range. Darkin Slayer: Additionally Knocks Up enemies hit for {{ e2 }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: Kayn can walk through terrain.
abilities.tooltip: Kayn gains {{ e1 }}% Move Speed , becomes Ghosted, and can move through Terrain for {{ e2 }} seconds. When he first enters terrain, he restores {{ totalhealing }} Health . Being Immobilized and spending more than {{ e3 }} consecutive seconds outside of Terrain ends this Ability early. Shadow Assassin: Gain {{ e5 }}% Move Speed , Slow immunity, and reduce the Cooldown to {{ assassincdreduction }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Umbral Trespass
abilities.description: Kayn hides in an enemy's body, dealing massive damage when he bursts out.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Champions damaged by Kayn are marked for 3.15 seconds. Kayn infests a marked enemy, becoming Untargetable. After {{ infestduration }} seconds or after Recasting , Kayn bursts out, dealing {{ damage }} physical damage to the enemy. Shadow Assassin: Increases this Ability's range, the distance Kayn exits, and refreshes The Darkin Scythe's Cooldown on exit. Darkin Slayer: Instead deals {{ slayerdamage }} max Health physical damage and restores {{ healvalue }} Health ({{ slayerhealpercent*100 }}% damage amount).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: An Acquired Taste
abilities.description: Tahm Kench puts the heft of his immense body behind his attacks, gaining extra damage based on his total health. Damaging enemy champions builds stacks of An Acquired Taste . At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion.

abilities.name: Tongue Lash
abilities.description: Tahm Kench lashes out with his tongue, damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion. Applies a stack of An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste , they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.
abilities.tooltip: Deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slows them by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. On champion hit, heals Tahm for {{ baseheal }} +{{ percenthealthhealing*100 }}% of his missing Health and applies a stack of An Acquired Taste dealing {{ spell.tahmkenchpassive:totaldamage }} extra magic damage . If that champion already had 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste , they will also be Stunned for {{ stunduration }} seconds, consuming the stacks. Activate Devour while your tongue is in midair to devour enemy champions who already have 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste from a distance when you hit them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Abyssal Dive
abilities.description: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area.
abilities.tooltip: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Knock Up all enemies in an area for {{ knockupduration }} second. Hitting at least one enemy champion refunds {{ champrefund*100 }}% of the Cooldown and Mana cost. Devoured allies can be taken along for the ride (but can always hop out early).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Thick Skin
abilities.description: Passive: Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat. Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: {{ greyhealthratio*100 }}% of damage Tahm Kench takes is stored by his Thick Skin , increased to {{ greyhealthratioenhanced*100 }}% if there are at least {{ enhancedthreshold }} nearby enemy champions. If Kench has not taken damage within {{ ooctimer }} seconds, Thick Skin will rapidly be consumed to heal Tahm for {{ greyhealthhealingratio }} of its value. Active: Convert all your stored Thick Skin into a Shield , lasting {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.description: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally.
abilities.tooltip: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds. He can Recast to spit them out. Enemy Champions: Require 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste . Are devoured for up to {{ enemyduration }} seconds and take {{ basedamage }} (+{{ percenthpdamage }} of their Max Health) magic damage . Tahm Kench is Slowed by {{ slowamount*100 }}% and Grounded during this effect. Ally Champions: Are devoured for up to {{ allyduration }} seconds and are granted {{ totalshield }} Shield which decays gradually after being spit out. Allies can also choose to exit early. Tahm Kench is Grounded during this effect, but can cast Abyssal Dive and gains {{ allyspeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ allyduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Gift of the Drowned Ones
abilities.description: When Pyke is hidden from enemies, he regenerates damage that he has recently taken from champions. Pyke also cannot gain extra Maximum Health from any source, and instead gains Bonus AD.

abilities.name: Bone Skewer
abilities.description: Pyke either stabs an enemy in front of him or pulls an enemy towards him.
abilities.tooltip: Tap: Pyke stabs, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to the first enemy hit, preferring champions. They are then Slowed by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second. Hold: Pyke throws his harpoon, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to the first enemy hit and Pulling them towards him. They are then Slowed by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second. If Pyke successfully hits an enemy champion or the channel does not complete successfully, {{ manarefund*100 }}% of the Mana cost is refunded.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ghostwater Dive
abilities.description: Pyke enters Camouflage and gains significant Move Speed that decays over time.
abilities.tooltip: Pyke gains Camouflage and {{ movespeed }}% Move Speed decaying over {{ e0 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Phantom Undertow
abilities.description: Pyke dashes and leaves behind a phantom that will return to him, stunning enemy champions along its path.
abilities.tooltip: Pyke dashes, leaving a drowned phantom behind him that returns to him shortly. The phantom Stuns for {{ stunduration }} seconds and deals {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to champions.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Death From Below
abilities.description: Pyke blinks to and executes low health enemies, allowing him to cast this spell again and granting additional gold to an ally who assists.
abilities.tooltip: Pyke strikes all enemy champions in an X, teleporting to and executing targets below {{ rdamage }} Health. Champions above the threshold and non-champions instead take physical damage equal to {{ reduceddamage*100 }}% of that amount ( {{ reduceddamagefinal }} ). When an enemy champion dies inside the X, Pyke can Recast this Ability for free within {{ rrecastduration }} seconds. If he executed that champion, the last assisting ally will also get kill gold. If he did not, he will still get kill gold as if he did. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: We Are More
abilities.description: Naafiri spawns packmates that attack the targets of her attacks and abilities.

abilities.name: Darkin Daggers
abilities.description: Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding. Packmates leap to attack the first champion or monster hit by this skill.
abilities.tooltip: Naafiri hurls Darkin-tainted blades, dealing {{ spell.naafiriq:totaldamagefirstcast }} physical damage and inflicting a bleed, dealing {{ spell.naafiriq:totalbleeddamage }} physical damage over {{ spell.naafiriq:bleedduration }} seconds. Naafiri can Recast this Ability. If enemies hit are already bleeding from this Ability, it instead deals the remaining bleed damage plus between {{ spell.naafiriq:totalmindamagesecondcast }} and {{ spell.naafiriq:totalmaxdamagesecondcast }} physical damage , based on their missing Health. If that target was a champion or large monster, Naafiri restores {{ spell.naafiriq:totalhealsecondcast }} Health . Packmates will leap at the first champion or monster hit and attack them for {{ spell.naafirip:packmatetauntduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: The Call of the Pack
abilities.description: Naafiri becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack, spawning additional packmates and gaining increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.
abilities.tooltip: Naafiri becomes Untargetable for {{ untargetableduration }} second and prepares to hunt, spawning {{ packmatestoadd }} additional Packmates and gaining {{ bonusad }} Attack Damage and {{ movespeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ duration }} seconds. Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Eviscerate
abilities.description: Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.
abilities.tooltip: Naafiri surges forward, dealing {{ totaldamagefirstslash }} physical damage , then explodes in a flurry of blades, dealing {{ totaldamagesecondslash }} physical damage. Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri restoring 100% Health . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Hounds' Pursuit
abilities.description: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, dealing damage. Naafiri reveals nearby enemies if she scores a takedown and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants a shield.
abilities.tooltip: Naafiri dashes at an enemy champion, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and briefly Slowing them. Packmates become Untargetable and dash alongside Naafiri, dealing {{ packmatedamage }} physical damage per Packmate . If Naafiri scores a Takedown within {{ takedownwindow }} seconds she reveals nearby enemies and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants {{ shieldtotal }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Joy Unending
abilities.description: Nilah gains increased experience from last-hitting minions along with the ability to enhance and share nearby healing and shielding from her allies.

abilities.name: Formless Blade
abilities.description: With a snap of her whip-blade, Nilah damages any enemies she hits in a straight line in her chosen direction. This action extends her attack range for a short duration.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Nilah gains {{ critarmorpen }} Armor Penetration, and her Attacks against champions restore {{ critlifesteal }} damage dealt as Health . Overhealing from this is converted into a Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. Active: Nilah cracks her whip-blade, dealing {{ damagecalc }} physical damage , increased by her Critical Strike Chance. If an enemy unit or structure is hit, Nilah gains 125 Attack Range and {{ bonusattackspeedcalc }}% Attack Speed , and her Attacks hit in a cone as {{ attacktotaldamagetooltip }} physical damage for {{ buffduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Jubilant Veil
abilities.description: Nilah envelops herself in mist, increasing her movement speed and allowing her to gracefully dodge all incoming attacks. Any allies she touches during the mist's duration will also gain this effect.
abilities.tooltip: Nilah envelops herself in mist for {{ baseduration }} seconds, becoming Ghosted, gaining {{ movespeedpercent*100 }}% Move Speed , dodging Attacks, and reducing magic damage taken by {{ magicdamagereduction*100 }}%. While active, touching allied champions envelops them in mist, granting the same benefits for {{ sharebaseduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Slipstream
abilities.description: Nilah enthusiastically dashes toward her target, dealing damage to any enemies she passes through on the way.
abilities.tooltip: Nilah dashes through a unit, dealing {{ dashdamage }} physical damage to any enemies she passes through.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Apotheosis
abilities.description: Twirling her whip-blade in joyful exuberance, Nilah deals damage to enemies around her before pulling them closer with her weapon.
abilities.tooltip: Nilah whirls her whip-blade, dealing {{ damagepertickcalctooltip }} physical damage over 1 second, then finishes with a burst of {{ damagecalc }} physical damage that also Pulls nearby enemies toward her. Nilah heals herself and nearby allies by {{ champhealingpercent }} (+{{ spell.nilahq:critlifesteal }} Formless Blade) of her damage dealt to enemy champions' Health ({{ otherhealingpercent*100 }}% for non-champions) , converting any overhealing into a Shield for {{ duration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Iceborn Subjugation
abilities.description: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and then, after a delay, shatter from the intense cold, dealing magic damage to nearby targets.

abilities.name: Ice Shard
abilities.description: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing Move Speed. Shards pass through the target, dealing the same damage to other enemies hit.
abilities.tooltip: Lissandra throws a spear of ice that shatters on the first enemy hit, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage , Slowing them by {{ e3 }}% for {{ e2 }} seconds, and also damaging and slowing the enemies behind them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ring of Frost
abilities.description: Freezes nearby enemies in ice, dealing magic damage and rooting them.
abilities.tooltip: Lissandra creates an ice field, Rooting nearby enemies for {{ e2 }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Glacial Path
abilities.description: Lissandra creates an ice claw that deals magic damage. Reactivating this ability transports Lissandra to the claw's current location.
abilities.tooltip: Lissandra casts forth an ice claw that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Lissandra can Recast while the claw travels to teleport to its location.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Frozen Tomb
abilities.description: If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it. If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable. Dark ice then emanates from the target dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing Move Speed.
abilities.tooltip: Lissandra encases herself or an enemy champion in ice. Enemies are Stunned for {{ enemycastduration }} seconds. When self cast, Lissandra enters Stasis for {{ selfcastduration }} seconds and restores {{ healamount }} Health , increased by {{ selfcastmissinghpratio }}% for each {{ selfcastmissinghpperabove }}% missing Health. In either case, dark ice eminates from the target, dealing {{ calculateddamage }} magic damage . The ice persists for {{ slowduration }} seconds, Slowing enemies by {{ slowamount*-100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Fleet of Foot
abilities.description: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

abilities.name: Boomerang Blade
abilities.description: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.
abilities.tooltip: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing {{ totaldamage }} to all enemies it cuts through. Hitting non-champions reduces the damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of {{ falloffminimum*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.description: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.
abilities.tooltip: For the next {{ buffduration }} seconds, Sivir gains {{ ricochetattackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed and her auto attacks are empowered to bounce to additional surrounding enemies dealing {{ bouncedamage }} physical damage each bounce for up to {{ maxbounces }} bounces. These bounces critically strike if the attack generating them does.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Spell Shield
abilities.description: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.
abilities.tooltip: Sivir creates a magical barrier for {{ e1 }} seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy Ability. If an ability is blocked, Sivir restores {{ totalheal }} health and triggers Fleet of Foot.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: On The Hunt
abilities.description: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.
abilities.tooltip: Sivir rallies her nearby allies, granting them {{ maxms*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ ultduration }} seconds. Sivir's attacks against champions while On The Hunt reduce the cooldown of her basic abilities by 0.5 seconds. Takedowns on recently damaged enemies refreshes the duration of the hunt.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Living Vengeance
abilities.description: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

abilities.name: Piercing Arrow
abilities.description: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.
abilities.tooltip: Begin Charging: Varus draws back his next shot, Slowing himself by {{ e7 }}%. After {{ e5 }} seconds, if not fired, Varus will cancel the Ability and refund {{ e4 }}% of its Mana cost. Release: Varus releases the arrow, dealing {{ totaldamagemintooltip }} physical damage , reduced by {{ e3 }}% per enemy hit (minimum {{ e9 }}%). Damage and Blight detonation effects are increased by up to {{ maxchargeamp*100 }}% based on charge time (maximum {{ totaldamagemax }} ) .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Blighted Quiver
abilities.description: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Varus' Attacks deal an additional {{ onhitdamage }} magic damage and apply a Blight stack for {{ e3 }} seconds (max {{ e4 }} stacks). Varus' other Abilities detonate Blight stacks dealing {{ percenthpperstack }} max Health magic damage per stack (max {{ maxpercenthpperstack }} max Health damage ). Detonating Blight on champions and epic monsters also reduces his basic Abilities' Cooldowns by {{ cdrperblightstack*100 }}% of their Maximum per stack. Active: Varus' next Piercing Arrow deals an additional {{ qempowerpercenthp }} missing Health magic damage , increased up to {{ maxqempowerpercenthp }} missing Health damage based on charge time.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Hail of Arrows
abilities.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.
abilities.tooltip: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deals {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and desecrates the ground for {{ e3 }} seconds, Slowing enemies by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}% and applying {{ grievousamount*100 }}% Grievous Wounds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Chain of Corruption
abilities.description: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.
abilities.tooltip: Varus flings out a tendril of corruption, Rooting the first champion hit for {{ e2 }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Rooted enemies gain {{ e4 }} Blight stacks over the duration. The corruption spreads from its target to uninfected enemy champions. If it reaches them, they take the same damage and Root .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Carnivore
abilities.description: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers Health and Mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.description: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.
abilities.tooltip: Cho'Gath ruptures the ground, Knocking Up enemies for {{ e5 }} second, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage , and Slowing them by {{ e2 }}% for {{ e3 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Feral Scream
abilities.description: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.
abilities.tooltip: Cho'Gath roars, Silencing enemies for {{ e2 }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Vorpal Spikes
abilities.description: Cho'Gath's attacks release deadly spikes, dealing damage and slowing all enemy units in front of him.
abilities.tooltip: Cho'Gath's next 3 Attacks launch spikes that deal {{ flatdamagecalc }} plus {{ maxhealthpercentcalc }} of the target's max Health magic damage and Slow by {{ slowamountpercentage }}%, decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.description: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum Health.
abilities.tooltip: Cho'Gath ravenously feeds on an enemy, dealing {{ rdamage }} true damage to champions or {{ rmonsterdamage }} to minions or jungle monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains a stack, which causes him to grow in size and gain {{ rhealthperstack }} max Health . Only {{ rminionmaxstacks }} stacks can be gained from minions and non-epic jungle monsters. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
abilities.description: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

abilities.name: Baleful Strike
abilities.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.
abilities.tooltip: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first two enemies hit. If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains {{ spell.veigarpassive:dqkillstacks }} stack of Phenomenal Evil . Large minions and large monsters grant {{ spell.veigarpassive:dqkillstackslarge }} stacks instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dark Matter
abilities.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.
abilities.tooltip: Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Every {{ spell.veigarpassive:pstacksperdarkmattercdr }} stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ spell.veigarpassive:darkmattercdrincrement*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Event Horizon
abilities.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.
abilities.tooltip: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through for {{ e1 }} seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Primordial Burst
abilities.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.
abilities.tooltip: Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between {{ mindamage }} and {{ maxdamage }} magic damage , increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Unseen Predator
abilities.description: While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack. Rengar generates Ferocity whenever he casts an ability. At Max Ferocity, his next ability is empowered. Killing enemy champions awards trophies on Rengar's Bonetooth Necklace , granting bonus attack damage.

abilities.name: Savagery
abilities.description: Rengar's next Attack brutally stabs his target for bonus damage. Ferocity effect: deals increased damage and grants Attack Speed.
abilities.tooltip: Rengar's next 2 Attacks gain {{ e5 }}% Attack Speed . The first Attack critically strikes for {{ F4 }} (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleCrit%) physical damage . Max Ferocity: The first Attack critically strikes for {{ F5 }} (%i:scaleLevel%%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleCrit%) physical damage and grants Rengar {{ empoweredqas }} Attack Speed for {{ e3 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Battle Roar
abilities.description: Rengar lets out a battle roar, damaging enemies and healing for some of the recent damage he has taken. Ferocity effect: additionally breaks crowd control effects.
abilities.tooltip: Rengar roars, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies and restoring {{ damagepercentagehealed }}% of the damage taken in the last {{ e3 }} seconds as Health. Max Ferocity: Deals {{ totaldamageempowered }} magic damage and additionally cleanses Rengar of crowd control.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Bola Strike
abilities.description: Rengar throws a bola, slowing the first target hit for a short duration. Ferocity effect: roots the target.
abilities.tooltip: Rengar throws a bola, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to the first enemy hit, revealing and Slowing them by {{ e2 }}% for {{ e3 }} seconds. Max Ferocity: Deals {{ totalempowereddamage }} physical damage and Roots for {{ e4 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Thrill of the Hunt
abilities.description: Rengar's predatory instincts take over, Camouflaging him and revealing the nearest enemy champion in a large radius around him. During Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar gains Move Speed and he can leap to the tracked enemy without being in brush, reducing their armor.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Rengar will also leap Attack when Camouflaged . Active: Rengar gains {{ stealthms }}% Move Speed and True Sight in a small area around the nearest enemy champion for {{ stealthduration }} seconds. After {{ fadetime }} seconds, Rengar becomes Camouflaged and can leap without being in Brush. Leaping to the nearest champion deals an additional {{ bonusdamage }} physical damage , shreds {{ armorshred }} Armor for {{ armorshredduration }} seconds, and ends this Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Bravado
abilities.description: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.

abilities.name: Starlight's Touch
abilities.description: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Gain a stack (max {{ e6 }}) every {{ stackcooldown }} seconds and when hitting a Bravado Attack. Active: Consume all stacks to restore {{ healingperstack }} Health per stack to nearby ally champions ( {{ maxstackhealing }} at {{ e6 }} stacks).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Bastion
abilities.description: Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion. Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.
abilities.tooltip: Passive: Taric gains {{ bonusarmor }} Armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by this Ability. As long as they are near each other, the ally gains {{ bonusarmor }} Armor and Taric casts all his Abilities from both himself and his linked ally. Active: Taric binds to an ally champion, granting a {{ e2 }}% max Health Shield for {{ e3 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dazzle
abilities.description: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.
abilities.tooltip: Taric projects a beam of starlight, bursting after {{ e3 }} second to deal {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Stun enemies for {{ e2 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Cosmic Radiance
abilities.description: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.
abilities.tooltip: Taric calls down protection from the heavens. After {{ initialdelay }} seconds, nearby ally champions become invulnerable for {{ invulnduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Way of the Hunter
abilities.description: Yone deals magic damage with every second Attack. In addition, his critical strike chance is increased.

abilities.name: Mortal Steel
abilities.description: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line. On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward with a gust of wind knocking enemies Airborne .
abilities.tooltip: Yone thrusts forward, dealing {{ qdamage }} physical damage . On hit, grants a stack for {{ buffduration }} seconds. At 2 stacks, this ability causes Yone to dash forward with a wave of wind that Knocks Up for {{ q3knockupduration }} seconds and deals {{ qdamage }} physical damage . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Spirit Cleave
abilities.description: Cleaves forward, damaging all enemies in a cone. Grants a shield to Yone, the value is increased by the number of champions hit by the swipe. Spirit Cleave's cooldown and cast time scale with attack speed.
abilities.tooltip: Yone cleaves forward, dealing {{ basedamage*0.5 }} + {{ maxhealthdamage*50 }}% max Health physical damage and {{ basedamage*0.5 }} + {{ maxhealthdamage*50 }}% max Health magic damage . If Yone hits, he gains {{ wshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. The amount of Shield increases for each champion struck. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Soul Unbound
abilities.description: Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed. When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit.
abilities.tooltip: Yone enters a spirit form for {{ returntimer }} seconds, leaving his body behind for the duration and gaining {{ startingms*100 }}% to {{ movementspeed*100 }}% ramping Move Speed . When the spirit form ends, Yone snaps back to his body and repeats {{ deathmarkpercent*100 }}% of all Attack and Ability damage he dealt to champions during this time. You may Recast this ability during spirit form. Recast: End spirit form early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Fate Sealed
abilities.description: Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him.
abilities.tooltip: Yone strikes all enemies along a path for {{ tooltipdamage }} physical damage and {{ tooltipdamage }} magic damage , teleporting behind the last champion hit and Knocking Up victims towards Yone.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Organic Deconstruction
abilities.description: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.

abilities.name: Plasma Fission
abilities.description: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.
abilities.tooltip: Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slowamount*100 }}% decaying over {{ slowduration }} second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting , the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle. Killing a unit with this restores {{ tooltipmanarefund }} Mana .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Void Rift
abilities.description: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.
abilities.tooltip: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing {{ initialdamage }} magic damage . The rift then erupts, dealing {{ secondarydamage }} magic damage . This Ability has 2 charges ({{ ammorechargetime }} second refresh).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Tectonic Disruption
abilities.description: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.
abilities.tooltip: Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, Knocking Up for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be Knocked Back instead of Knocked Up .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
abilities.description: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.
abilities.tooltip: Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by {{ e3 }}%. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by Organic Deconstruction . Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Spiked Shell
abilities.description: Rammus gains bonus Attack Damage scaling with his Armor and Magic Resistance.

abilities.name: Powerball
abilities.description: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.
abilities.tooltip: Rammus curls into a ball, gaining {{ minimummovespeed }} Move Speed , accelerating up to {{ maximummovespeed }} Move Speed over {{ rollduration }} seconds. Rammus stops after colliding with an enemy, dealing {{ powerballdamage }} magic damage , Knocking Back , and Slowing nearby enemies by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ slowduration }} second. Recast : Rammus ends this Ability early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Defensive Ball Curl
abilities.description: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, and returning damage to enemies that attack him.
abilities.tooltip: Rammus enters a defensive formation for {{ buffduration }} seconds, gaining {{ bonusarmortooltip }} Armor and {{ bonusmrtooltip }} Magic Resist and dealing {{ returndamagecalc }} magic damage to enemies that Attack him. Recast : Rammus ends this Ability early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Frenzying Taunt
abilities.description: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him.
abilities.tooltip: Rammus Taunts an enemy champion or monster for {{ duration }} seconds. Monsters are dealt {{ monsterdamagecalc }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Soaring Slam
abilities.description: Rammus hops into the air and slams down at a target area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If cast while Rammus is in Powerball, Rammus knocks up enemies near the center as well.
abilities.tooltip: Rammus hops into the air and slams down in an area, dealing {{ initialdamagecalc }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. If used during Powerball , enemies in the center take an additional {{ spell.powerball:powerballdamage }} magic damage and are Knocked Up for {{ knockupduration }} seconds. Rammus then creates {{ numberofpulses }} aftershocks in the area over {{ buffduration }} seconds, repeating the Slow . The range of this Ability is increased by Rammus's Move Speed .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Voracity
abilities.description: Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced. If Katarina picks up a Dagger , she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.

abilities.name: Bouncing Blade
abilities.description: Katarina throws a Dagger at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.
abilities.tooltip: Katarina throws a Dagger , dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the target and {{ maxbounces }} nearby enemies. The Dagger then ricochets onto the ground behind the primary target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Preparation
abilities.description: Katarina gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a Dagger into the air directly above herself.
abilities.tooltip: Katarina tosses a Dagger into the air and gains {{ e4 }}% Move Speed decaying over {{ e2 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Shunpo
abilities.description: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.
abilities.tooltip: Katarina blinks in the wink of an eye to the target ally, enemy, or Dagger . If it is an enemy, Katarina strikes for {{ totaldamage }} magic damage - otherwise she strikes the nearest enemy in range. Picking up a Dagger will reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ daggercooldownreduction }} seconds ( {{ tooltipdaggerreduction }} ). Katarina can blink to any location near the target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Death Lotus
abilities.description: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.
abilities.tooltip: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, rapidly attacking the three nearest enemy champions with a flurry of knives. Each knife deals {{ damagecalc }} magic damage and {{ addamagecalc }} physical damage , and applies {{ grievousamount*100 }}% Grievous Wounds for {{ grievousduration }} seconds. Total over {{ duration }} seconds to each enemy: {{ totaldamagecalc }} magic damage and {{ totaladdamagecalc }} physical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Noxious Slipstream
abilities.description: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.

abilities.name: Poison Trail
abilities.description: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.
abilities.tooltip: Toggle: Singed lays a poisonous trail that deals {{ damagepersecond }} magic damage per second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mega Adhesive
abilities.description: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.
abilities.tooltip: Singed hurls a cask of sticky liquid, Grounding and Slowing enemies in the area by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ wduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Fling
abilities.description: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.
abilities.tooltip: Singed flings an enemy over his shoulder, dealing {{ basedamage }} plus {{ e3 }}% max Health magic damage . If Singed flings a target into his Mega Adhesive , they are Rooted for {{ e2 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Insanity Potion
abilities.description: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.
abilities.tooltip: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him {{ statamount }} Ability Power , Armor , Magic Resist , Move Speed , Health Regen , and Mana Regen for {{ duration }} seconds. During this effect, Singed's Poison Trail also applies {{ grievousamount*100 }}% Grievous Wounds for {{ grievousduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Power Chord
abilities.description: Accelerando : Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead. Power Chord : Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.

abilities.name: Hymn of Valor
abilities.description: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.
abilities.tooltip: Sona deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the nearest two enemies, prioritizing champions. She then begins a new Melody . Gain a stack of Accelerando for every champion you damage with this. Melody: Sona gains an aura for {{ auraduration }} seconds, granting allied champions an additional {{ totalonhitdamage }} magic damage %i:OnHit% on their next Attack within {{ onhitduration }} seconds. Power Chord - Staccato: Power Chord bonus damage ( {{ totalstaccatodamage }} total magic damage ).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Aria of Perseverance
abilities.description: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.
abilities.tooltip: Active: Sona restores {{ totalheal }} Health to herself and a nearby allied champion, prioritizing the most wounded. She then begins a new Melody . Melody: Sona gains an aura for {{ auraduration }} seconds, granting allied champions {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. Gain a stack of Accelerando whenever you heal another injured ally and every time you protect another ally from at least {{ accelerandoshieldbreakpoint }} damage with this shield. Power Chord - Diminuendo: Power Chord also reduces physical and magic damage dealt by the target by {{ totaldiminuendoweakenpercent }} for {{ diminuendoduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Song of Celerity
abilities.description: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.
abilities.tooltip: Active: She begins a new Melody and grants herself {{ totalselfmovementspeed }} Move Speed for {{ selfmovementspeeddurationmin }} seconds, extended to up to {{ selfmovementspeeddurationmax }} seconds if she doesn't take damage. Melody: Sona gains an aura for {{ auraduration }} seconds that grants allied champions {{ totalallymovementspeed }} Move Speed for {{ allymovementspeedduration }} seconds. Power Chord - Tempo: Power Chord also Slows the target by {{ totaltempomovespeedslow }} for {{ tempoduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Crescendo
abilities.description: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.
abilities.tooltip: Sona strikes an irresistible chord, Stunning enemy for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Vow of the First Lands
abilities.description: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Cultivation of Spirit
abilities.description: Yunara gains Attack Speed, bonus damage On-Hit, and her Attacks spread to nearby enemies.
abilities.tooltip: Passive : Yunara deal {{ calc_passive_damage }} magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit and attacking grants {{ resource_nonchampion }} Unleash ( {{ resource_champion }} Unleash for champions). Active : Yunara consumes {{ resource_max }} Unleash and for {{ buff_duration }} seconds gains {{ calc_attack_speed }} Attack Speed and deals an additional {{ calc_damage }} magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit . During this time, her Attacks spread to nearby enemies dealing them {{ calc_damage_spread }} physical damage . Transcendent State : This Ability is instantly activated for {{ spell.yunarar:buff_duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Arc of Judgment | Arc of Ruin
abilities.description: Yunara fires a spinning prayer bead that deals damage and slows enemies. While in her Transcendent State she instead fires off a laser that deals damage and slows enemies.
abilities.tooltip: Yunara lets rip a prayer bead that deals {{ calc_damage_initial }} magic damage and Slows by {{ calc_slow }} decaying over {{ slow_duration }} seconds . It deals an additional {{ calc_damage_per_second }} magic damage per second. Transcendent State - Arc of Ruin : Yunara fires a laser that deals {{ spell.yunarar:calc_rw_damage }} magic damage and Slows by {{ spell.yunarar:calc_rw_slow_amount }} decaying over {{ spell.yunarar:rw_slow_duration }} second .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Kanmei's Steps | Untouchable Shadow
abilities.description: Yunara gains decaying Move Speed and becomes Ghosted. While in her Transcendent State she instead dashes in a direction.
abilities.tooltip: Yunara gains {{ calc_move_speed }} Move Speed , increased to {{ calc_move_speed_enhanced }} Move Speed when moving toward an enemy champion, for {{ buff_duration }} seconds. Transcendent State - Untouchable Shadow : Yunara dashes in a direction.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Transcend One's Self
abilities.description: Yunara enters a Transcendent State that upgrades her basic Abilities.
abilities.tooltip: Yunara enters a Transcendent State for {{ buff_duration }} seconds upgrading her basic Abilities for the duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Crimson Pact
abilities.description: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).

abilities.name: Transfusion
abilities.description: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.
abilities.tooltip: Vladimir drains his target's lifeforce, dealing {{ basedamagetooltip }} magic damage and restoring {{ basehealtooltip }} Health . After using this Ability twice, Vladimir gains {{ movementspeedonq2 }}% Move Speed for 0.5 seconds and empowers the next use of this Ability for {{ e8 }} seconds. The empowered version of this Ability deals {{ empowereddamagetooltip }} magic damage instead and restores an additional {{ empoweredhealtooltip }} plus {{ empoweredhealpercenttooltip }} missing Health .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Sanguine Pool
abilities.description: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.
abilities.tooltip: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood for 2 seconds, gaining {{ hasteboost*100 }}% decaying Move Speed for {{ hasteduration }} second and becoming Untargetable and Ghosted while Slowing enemies in the pool by {{ movespeedmod*-100 }}%. Vladimir deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and restores {{ totalheal }} Health per enemy over the duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Tides of Blood
abilities.description: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.
abilities.tooltip: Begin Charging: Vladimir charges up a reservoir of blood, spending up to {{ chargehealthtooltip }} Health . While at full charge, Vladimir is Slowed by 20%. Release: Vladimir unleashes a torrent of blood missiles at surrounding enemies, dealing between {{ mindamagetooltip }} and {{ maxdamagetooltip }} magic damage based on charge time. If this Ability was charged for at least 1 second, it also Slows targets by {{ slowpercent }}% for 0.5 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
abilities.resource: Channeling Cost {{ e2 }}% of max Health ({{ chargehealthtooltip }})

abilities.name: Hemoplague
abilities.description: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.
abilities.tooltip: Vladimir creates a virulent plague, causing its victims to take {{ e2 }}% increased damage from all sources for {{ e4 }} seconds. After it expires, Vladimir deals {{ damage }} magic damage to all infected targets. Vladimir restores {{ damage }} Health if he hits a champion, and restores an additional {{ secondaryhealingtooltip }} Health for each champion beyond the first.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Way of the Wanderer
abilities.description: Yasuo's Critical Strike Chance is increased. Additionally, Yasuo builds toward a shield whenever he is moving. The shield triggers when he takes damage from a champion or monster.

abilities.name: Steel Tempest
abilities.description: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line. On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest fires a whirlwind that knocks Airborne . Steel Tempest is treated as a basic attack and scales with all the same things.
abilities.tooltip: Yasuo thrusts, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage . If he hits, he gains a stack for {{ gatheringstormduration }} seconds. While he has 2 stacks, his next use of this Ability fires a whirlwind from range, dealing the same damage and Knocking Up for {{ knockupdurationtooltiponly }} second. If used while dashing, this Ability strikes in a circle rather than a stab.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Wind Wall
abilities.description: Creates a moving wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.
abilities.tooltip: Yasuo creates a drifting wall of wind that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Sweeping Blade
abilities.description: Dashes through target enemy, dealing magic damage. Each cast increases subsequent dash's damage, up to a max amount. Cannot be re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds. If Steel Tempest is cast while dashing, it will strike as a circle.
abilities.tooltip: Yasuo dashes through a target, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage . Each use of this Ability grants {{ bonusdamageperstack }} bonus damage to subsequent uses for {{ stackduration }} seconds, stacking up to {{ maxstacks }} times. This Ability has a {{ e2 }} second per-target Cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Last Breath
abilities.description: Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing physical damage and holding all Airborne enemies in the area in the air. Grants maximum Flow but resets all stacks of Gathering Storm. For a moderate time afterwards, Yasuo's critical strikes gain significant Bonus Armor Penetration.
abilities.tooltip: Yasuo teleports to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing {{ damage }} physical damage and holding all nearby Airborne enemies up for an additional {{ rknockupduration }} second. Yasuo also gains maximum Flow , but loses all Steel Tempest stacks. Afterwards, Yasuo's critical strikes ignore {{ rpercentarmorpen }}% bonus Armor for {{ rbuffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Rock Surfing
abilities.description: Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.

abilities.name: Threaded Volley
abilities.description: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts. This creates Worked Ground below her. If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.
abilities.tooltip: Taliyah hurls 5 rocks, each dealing {{ rockdamage }} magic damage in an area around the first enemy hit while creating Worked Ground at that area. Subsequent hits against the same enemy deal {{ extramissilereduceddamagepercent }}% less damage. Casts on worked ground cost {{ e7 }} Mana and have {{ workedgroundcdr*100 }}% less Cooldown, consume the Worked Ground, and hurl a boulder that Slows enemies it hits by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds, dealing {{ bigrockdamage }} magic damage to the primary target. Monsters hit by the boulder are Stunned for {{ monsterstunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Seismic Shove
abilities.description: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.
abilities.tooltip: Taliyah quakes the earth, Knocking enemies in an area in the chosen direction.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Unraveled Earth
abilities.description: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.
abilities.tooltip: Taliyah scatters loose stones in an area, Slowing enemies hit by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% and dealing {{ scatterdamage }} magic damage . The stones detonate when enemies dash or are Knocked through them, Stunning for the remaining movement duration + {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing {{ detonationdamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Weaver's Wall
abilities.description: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.
abilities.tooltip: Taliyah creates a massive earthen wall for {{ e1 }} seconds. If she immediately Recasts , she will ride along the wall as it unravels. Moving or being immobilized will end the ride. This ability cannot be cast if Taliyah has taken damage from Champions or structures within the last {{ damagelockouttime }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Deadly Venom
abilities.description: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target, dealing true damage each second.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.description: Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration. When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.
abilities.tooltip: Twitch Camouflages and gains {{ e3 }}% Move Speed for {{ e2 }} seconds. The Move Speed increases to {{ e3 }}% while near an enemy champion that can't see him. After exiting Camouflage , Twitch gains {{ e1 }}% Attack Speed for {{ e6 }} seconds. When an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Venom , this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Venom Cask
abilities.description: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.
abilities.tooltip: Twitch hurls a cask that adds a stack of Deadly Venom to all enemies struck and leaves behind a toxic cloud that persists for {{ duration }} seconds. Enemies that remain within the cloud are Slowed by {{ totalslowamount }}% and receive an additional stack of Deadly Venom each second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Contaminate
abilities.description: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.
abilities.tooltip: Deals {{ basedamage }} physical damage to all nearby enemies affected by Deadly Venom , plus an additional {{ physicaldamageperstack }} physical damage and {{ magicdamageperstack }} magical damage per stack of Deadly Venom . Max Damage: {{ maxphysicaldamage }} physical damage and {{ maxmagicdamage }} magical damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Spray and Pray
abilities.description: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.
abilities.tooltip: Twitch unleashes his crossbow, gaining {{ bonusrange }} Attack Range and {{ bonusad }} Attack Damage , and causing his Attacks to become piercing bolts for {{ duration }} seconds. These bolts hit all enemies they pass through, but deal {{ falloffdamage*100 }}% less damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of {{ minimumfalloffdamage*100 }}% damage. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Threads of Vibration
abilities.description: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.

abilities.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
abilities.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.
abilities.tooltip: Skarner rips a boulder from the ground, empowering his next 3 Attacks with {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed and dealing {{ abilitydamage }} physical damage to surrounding enemies. His final Attack will deal an additional {{ maxhppercent*100 }}% max Health physical damage and Slow affected foes by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s. Recast: Skarner ends this Ability and throws his boulder, dealing {{ spell.skarnerq:abilitydamage }} + {{ spell.skarnerq:maxhppercent*100 }}% max Health physical damage , and additionally Slowing the first enemy hit — and any other surrounding enemies — by {{ spell.skarnerq:slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ spell.skarnerq:slowduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Seismic Bastion
abilities.description: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.
abilities.tooltip: Skarner gains {{ initialshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }}s and triggers an earthquake that deals {{ damage }} magic damage and Slows nearby enemies by {{ sloweffect*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ixtal's Impact
abilities.description: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.
abilities.tooltip: Skarner charges forward, steering toward the chosen direction and ignoring terrain. If he runs into a champion or large monster, Skarner drags them along for the rest of his charge. Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals {{ pindamage }} physical damage to the enemy and Stuns them for {{ stunduration }}s. Skarner can Recast this Ability to end his charge early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.description: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.
abilities.tooltip: Skarner's tails lash forward, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and Suppressing the first 3 champions he hits for {{ duration }}s. Those hit are dragged along by Skarner for the duration of this Ability. If Skarner hits at least one champion he gains {{ speedboostamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ speedboostduration }} seconds. If Shattered Earth is active, Skarner will cast Upheaval first.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Night Hunter
abilities.description: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

abilities.name: Tumble
abilities.description: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.
abilities.tooltip: Vayne rolls a short distance, and deals an additional {{ adratiobonus }} physical damage on her next Attack. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
